net.timeout: NUXIVA at {host}:{port} is not answering (timed out). Most likely causes: the server is off or changed IP address, this PC is on another network (VPN, guest Wi-Fi), or the server firewall blocks port {port}. Try in PowerShell: Test-NetConnection {host} -Port {port}
net.refused: NUXIVA at {host}:{port} refused the connection: the computer is on but nothing listens on that port. Check that NUXIVA is running on the server and that the address and port are correct.
net.unreachable: No network path to {host}:{port}. Check that this PC is on the same network as the server (cable, Wi-Fi or VPN).
net.dns: The name {host} does not resolve to an address. Use the server's IP address or check the network DNS.
net.tls: Secure connection to {host}:{port} failed ({detail}). Check this PC's date and time and that the NUXIVA certificate has not changed.
net.loopback: The saved address ({host}:{port}) points to this same PC, not to the server. Pair the PC again using the server's real address, for example 192.168.1.100.
net.no_address: No server address saved: pair the PC again.
net.probe.port_timeout: • Port {port}: no answer (likely firewall or wrong address)

access.microphone.title: Windows is blocking the microphone for NUXIVA
access.microphone.what: Microphone access is turned off in the Windows privacy settings, for this PC or for desktop apps.
access.microphone.why: Without a microphone NUXIVA cannot hear the «Nuxiva» command or your voice: only typing in the panel remains.
access.microphone.how: Press the button below, turn on «Microphone access» and «Let desktop apps access your microphone». Then restart NUXIVA.
access.webcam.title: Windows is blocking the camera for NUXIVA
access.webcam.what: Camera access is turned off in the Windows privacy settings.
access.webcam.why: NUXIVA takes a single photo, and only when you ask, for example to tell you what you are holding.
access.webcam.how: Press the button below, turn on «Camera access» and «Let desktop apps access your camera». Then restart NUXIVA.
access.location.title: Windows is blocking location for NUXIVA
access.location.what: Location services are turned off in the Windows privacy settings.
access.location.why: They are needed for weather, routes and place-based reminders.
access.location.how: Press the button below and turn on «Location services» and access for desktop apps.
